notes.title: "Update 1.2"
notes.content:
1. **Technical Improvements and Functionality**

- Added texture compiler at game launch.

- Fixed stutters.

- Fixed settings issues.

- Added key binding options.

- Added control inversion option.


2. **Graphics and Visual Effects**

- Minor graphical fixes.

- Fixed texture bugs with crates and their malfunction when starting the "Quarantine" location.

- Changed visual effect for bug destruction.

- Removed RTX and DLSS bug on GPUs below 3070 (artifacts and incorrect location rendering).

- Various small texture and code fixes for improved game optimization.


3. **Gameplay Fixes and Mechanics**

- Fixed bug with sprint interruptions.

- Added ability to sprint diagonally without interruption.

- Fixed game freeze bug when picking up an access card.

- Added fire damage.

- Slightly increased stamina while running.

- Adjusted weapon ammo balance.

- Slightly increased headshot damage.

- Fixed character getting stuck in the sewer location.

- Reduced bug spawns in the lab location.

- Fixed barnacle disappearing when killed too quickly.

- Changed boss spawn in the "Quarantine" location.

- Fixed slowdown bugs in the sewer.


4. **Location Fixes and Improvements**

- Removed some invisible walls.

- Fixed funicular bug.

- Fixed random barrel spawns in the lab.

- Fixed door jamming bug in the terminal.

- Fixed teleport bug sending players to another location.

- Fixed bug where a scientist would disappear.

- Added additional monster spawns.


5. **AI and Difficulty Adjustments**

- Reworked robot AI.

- Difficulty adjustment: more enemies now spawn at higher difficulty levels.

- Fixed bug with elevator interface button appearance.


6. **Sound and Effects**

- Fixed sound bugs.


7. **Interface and Interaction**

- Interface improvements.

- Added interactive links.


Thank you all for your patience, I'm still recovering from my illness, so updates are rarely released.

I will add Chinese localization in the coming days

Thank you all! Have a good game!

notes.title: Update: 0.9.9.4
notes.content:
[h1][b]The update includes:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] New items and locations
[*] New types of enemies
[/list]

[b]Added locations:[/b]

[list]
[*] Technical room
[*] Dining room
[*] Shower room
[*] Improvements to the room with phantom copies
[/list]

[b]Changes in mechanics:[/b]

[list]
[*] Weapon balance fixed
[*] Increased reload and shooting volume, enhanced weapon recoil for better shooting experience
[/list]

[b]Battles and bosses:[/b]

[list]
[*] Completely reworked boss fight on the 3rd location
[*] Replaced soundtrack for the boss battle
[*] Added new boss - Shadow Stalker (can summon its copies and teleport when taking critical damage)
[/list]

[b]New enemies:[/b]

[list]
[*] Grabber (a biomass growth hanging on the wall that releases a pathogenic worm to capture passing living organisms)
[*] Swarm (moves between nests, attacks living organisms that approach it)
[*] Scientist in protective gear (similar to regular zombies, but has a vulnerability in the form of an oxygen tank on its back)
[*] Copy (rushes to the character, making short teleports in space, dealing serious damage upon reaching the player)
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Version 1.0.7
notes.content:
Changes:
- Fixed sound and music settings
- Lens flare setting has been removed from the menu, as it is not displayed correctly when shooting
- Reduced the head sway/bob parameter, when taking damage, from barrels and monsters ( now practically none)

- Shotgun power changed from 25 to 45
- Increased the shotgun clip from 6 rounds to 8
- Increased knife attack range from 200 to 300 and hitbox radius from 10 to 20

- Added button fixes related to the gamepad
- The gamepad key designations have also been added to the settings menu
- Fixed a bug after killing robots that left objects in the air

- Changed the health of monsters :
- The spit now has 270 health units, there were 400
- An ordinary zombie has 170 health units, there were 200

- Fixed the difficulty level, including the damage multiplier :
- The difficulty levels "difficult" and "expert" have a slightly lower damage multiplier and HP than before.
